meta.direction: Soft UI (neumorphic) everywhere, premium: one canvas color for ground and objects, depth by dual shadows, no outlines, large radii, generous spacing, gradient brand. Accessibility locked by tokens: text tokens meet WCAG AA on their grounds in both themes.
meta.source: C:/Dev/Tempo-Design reference board (31 images) + options page https://claude.ai/artifact/5yhLE2tBY7QfkkDq3ciqou
meta.theme-priority: Light is the face of the product (Kris, 2026-10-13). Polish lands in light first; dark must stay correct and legible but is not the reference.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page and the material every object is made of. Raised and sunken objects cast shadow-raise / shadow-sunken onto it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised objects: cards, the sidebar rail, dialogs. Almost the canvas color (objects are cut from the same material); depth comes from shadow-raise, never from a border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, the segmented track, progress tracks, toggle track, banners. Pairs with shadow-sunken.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered table rows, ghost-button hover, menu item hover.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (15:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, table headers, helper text. 6.4:1 on surface, 5.5:1 on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, decorative icons only (3.1:1 light): never for text under 24px that must be read.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on ink-filled surfaces (tooltips, the dark toast).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and lists only, as an embossed hairline (1px line over 1px highlight). No borders on cards, inputs or buttons.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning (3:1): input borders on hover, checkbox outlines, chart axes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px. 5.6:1 on surface light, 8.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Tempo teal. Primary button fill, active nav item, selected day, toggle on-state, progress ring. Text on it: on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand, brand-hover, brand-pressed (5.6:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active segmented option tint, teal chips, today's column tint.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Teal text: on brand-soft (7.5:1 light, 7.9:1 dark), links on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The logo mark, the ring's end cap, decorative teal at full depth. Not for text.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: The light stop of the brand gradient (brand-light → brand), 135deg, on the primary button, the ring fill and the toggle on-state. Never text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The light edge of every raised and sunken object (the second color in shadow-raise and shadow-sunken) and the 1px inset top highlight on raised slabs.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: The dark edge of every raised and sunken object (the first color in shadow-raise and shadow-sunken). Decorative only.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational icons and bars. Pair text with info-ink, not this.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info banners and chips.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-soft (5.2:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icons, the confirmed check, positive bars.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the 'confirmed' chip and success banners.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft (5.3:1 light, 8.6:1 dark). Always paired with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons and the 'waiting' dot. Not for text.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the 'waiting' chip and warning banners.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-soft (5.2:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill, error icons, the 'cancelled' dot. Text on it: on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the 'cancelled' chip, error banners, invalid-field helper.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on danger-soft and on surface (5.9:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on the danger fill.

tokens.name: cat-teal
tokens.usage: Class category 1 (default: yoga). The event block's edge and fill bar.

tokens.name: cat-teal-soft
tokens.usage: Category 1 event block background.

tokens.name: cat-teal-ink
tokens.usage: Category 1 text on cat-teal-soft.

tokens.name: cat-blue
tokens.usage: Class category 2 (default: pilates). Edge and fill bar.

tokens.name: cat-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Category 2 event block background.

tokens.name: cat-blue-ink
tokens.usage: Category 2 text on cat-blue-soft.

tokens.name: cat-violet
tokens.usage: Class category 3 (default: dance, movement). Edge and fill bar.

tokens.name: cat-violet-soft
tokens.usage: Category 3 event block background.

tokens.name: cat-violet-ink
tokens.usage: Category 3 text on cat-violet-soft (6.1:1 light).

tokens.name: cat-pink
tokens.usage: Class category 4 (default: barre, women-only). Edge and fill bar.

tokens.name: cat-pink-soft
tokens.usage: Category 4 event block background.

tokens.name: cat-pink-ink
tokens.usage: Category 4 text on cat-pink-soft (5.5:1 light).

tokens.name: cat-amber
tokens.usage: Class category 5 (default: HIIT, strength). Edge and fill bar.

tokens.name: cat-amber-soft
tokens.usage: Category 5 event block background.

tokens.name: cat-amber-ink
tokens.usage: Category 5 text on cat-amber-soft (5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: cat-green
tokens.usage: Class category 6 (default: kids, outdoor). Edge and fill bar.

tokens.name: cat-green-soft
tokens.usage: Category 6 event block background.

tokens.name: cat-green-ink
tokens.usage: Category 6 text on cat-green-soft (5.3:1 light).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page hero numbers and the member app greeting. One per screen.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Big stat values (occupancy, revenue). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Event block titles, dialog titles, list item titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: השיעור מתקיים בסטודיו 2 עם דנה כהן.
styles.usage: Long reading text, dialog bodies, the member app body.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, form values, descriptions.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Event block details, helper text, secondary rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, chips, segmented options, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, footnotes, axis labels. ink-muted, never ink-faint.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, API paths, webhook payloads. Always dir=ltr.

spacing.note: 4px base, generous: objects breathe. Component padding uses 3, 4; card padding 6 (phone) and 8 (desktop); section gaps 8, 10.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, chip inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; event block padding; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button horizontal padding; gap between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between cards; the page side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; chip row gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between sections in a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; page side gutter on desktop; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of page padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing and onboarding sections only.

radius.note: Big and soft. Objects are rounded slabs; the smaller the object, the closer to a pill.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Event tiles, menu items, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, flat-ish buttons inside tables, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips with actions, small cards, dialogs on phones.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, class cards, the sidebar rail, dialogs on desktop, the segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the phone frame, hero tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, toggles, avatars, the today marker, the progress ring.

shadow.note: One material, two directions. Raised objects (cards, buttons, knobs, rings) use shadow-raise / shadow-raise-sm; wells (inputs, tracks, banners) use shadow-sunken; nothing has a border. Light comes from the top-start corner. shadow-float only for things that leave the surface (menus, dialogs, toasts).

tokens.name: shadow-flat
tokens.usage: Only for things printed on paper: PDF exports, email. Not used in the apps.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar rail, class cards, stat tiles, dialogs, the primary button at rest (with shadow-brand instead).

tokens.name: shadow-raise-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary and icon buttons, the segmented knob, the toggle knob, chips, event tiles, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, the segmented track, progress tracks, the toggle track.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: The primary button only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons, chips with actions, table-row buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions in the member app and in dialogs.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of anything tappable on a phone, even when it looks smaller.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The sidebar rail width on desktop (icon buttons with labels on hover); 264px when expanded.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width in the consoles.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Toggle, chip, segmented option moves; menu open.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet enter; toast enter. Reduced motion: 0.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or moves.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, popovers.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky page header and the schedule's day header row.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: The scrim.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, always on top.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: two-column stat tiles.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: the sidebar collapses to icons below this.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: the week schedule shows all seven days.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: content stops growing at content-max.
